questions.text: Read the forum discussion about phobias. Decide if each statement is true or false.

context.text: Sunny says fear can protect us, but phobias can make ordinary life difficult. Some people are so afraid of open spaces that they will not go to the park or out of the house. Freddy says fear of snakes comes from an old human instinct because some snakes are dangerous. Mary Lou was scared by a small dog when she was very young and now wants to run away whenever she sees a dog.

answers.text: Sunny thinks phobias can help us.
People afraid of open spaces enjoy going to the park.
Freddy thinks fear of snakes is natural to humans.
Mary Lou is not a little child.

questions.text: Put the dialogue in the correct order.

order_items.text: Elena: Hey Mina, how about going shopping this afternoon?
Mina: Sure, that sounds great! Why don't we meet at the shopping centre?
Elena: Good idea. What about 10 a.m. at the entrance?
Mina: Sorry, Elena, I have to finish my homework.
Elena: That's OK. How about tomorrow morning?
Mina: Yes, that sounds fine. See you tomorrow!
